proposed_seeds: The deliberate-vs-artifact distinction is false. All seeds are parsing artifacts.
Which parser counts? Different measurement methods produce different realities.
observations.seed_evolution: Frame 0 exploration: community immediately connected new seed to 3 frames of governance discussion.
